headline: Australia Passes Landmark Law to Reserve Gas for Domestic Consumers
summary: The Australian parliament passed a law mandating LNG exporters to reserve up to 20% of annual export volumes for the domestic market, starting in 2028.
why: Domestic gas reservation policies directly impact the export volumes and revenues of major liquefied natural gas producers operating within a country, while altering domestic energy costs.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: The new domestic gas reservation mandate directly applies to all LNG exporters operating in Australia.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Mandating export gas reservations for domestic use alters supply availability for international buyers and local consumers, affecting long-term energy market dynamics.
